## Checklist for rule changes
- [ ] Old rules were **ended** (`"to": "YYYY-MM-DD"`), not edited, so past dates still work
- [ ] `source` links to the official page; `lastVerified` is today; `verifiedBy` is my name

- [ ] New text keys exist in English, Spanish, and Armenian
- [ ] `npm test` passes
